title: Voyah Music 0.2.5
notes:
First GitHub release of Voyah Music and Voyah Music Transfer, the offline music player for the head unit and the companion for your Android phone.

- Pair the phone with the head unit by QR code and transfer songs over local Wi-Fi. Transfers skip identical files and offer Replace, Keep both, or Skip when filenames conflict.
- Play saved music offline, organize tracks into folders, search by title, artist, or album, and sort the library. Delete a folder and its tracks with confirmation.
- The list settles on the playing track, and a live spectrum or waveform follows the sound. Use steering-wheel media controls and the Open Voyah Controls home-screen media card.
- Both apps support English, Russian, and Kazakh and can download signed updates from Settings.

Install **VoyahMusic-v0.2.5.apk** on the head unit and **VoyahMusicTransfer-v0.2.5.apk** on the phone. Both require Android 9 or later. If you installed a debug preview, back up any local music before replacing it with this release. Android requires a reinstall when the signing certificate changes.
